prompt: Hibernate Search MassIndexer MySQL JDBC idFetchSize value
answer:
For Hibernate Search’s `MassIndexer`, set `idFetchSize` to `Integer.MIN_VALUE` when using MySQL:

```java
massIndexer.idFetchSize(Integer.MIN_VALUE);
```

Hibernate Search documentation says MySQL may benefit from this value; otherwise, it may preload all primary keys into memory.
